answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a sunk 50-credit fee at registration, like a jetty toll collected before a vessel docks, and the fee is burned, never refunded. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits, far more than the few hundred those fakes could harvest in one epoch. An honest agent pays once, keeps undiluted rewards, and pays no repeat charge; no whisper among fakes waives the fee, and no sonnet of excuses changes the arithmetic.
